description: This file defines the EmployeeAllowedSkillAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for listing the skills allowed for a specific employee in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for fetching the data, validation rules, and handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve employee skill information with support for sorting and pagination.
